$comment: Device-side policy values you expect to find under
after your Intune notification profile has applied.
These are the five settings of the 'enriched native' baseline described in the README.
Together they produce a T-24h / T-4h / T-60min escalation where every notification must
be dismissed explicitly by the user.
Adjust the values to match your own profile, then run Get-UpdateEvidence.ps1.

$notes.ScheduleImminentRestartWarning: minutes - final warning. 15..60. Default is 15; 60 gives the user a real chance to react
$notes.SetAutoRestartNotificationDisable: 0 = notifications ENABLED. The label is counter-intuitive: 1 disables them
$notes.AutoRestartRequiredNotificationDismissal: 1 = auto dismissal, 2 = USER dismissal. 2 is the setting that matters: the notification does not clear itself, so the user cannot claim in good faith that they were never told
